# Pixel Black Box

> > A CGI artist's technical blog covering V-Ray, Arnold, Mental Ray rendering workflows, automotive visualization, and multi-pass compositing in Maya and Nuke.

This is the personal blog of DBailey, a CGI/VFX artist specializing in automotive visualization, 3D modeling, and rendering. The site documents technical workflows, renderer comparisons, and production projects using industry-standard tools like Maya, V-Ray, Arnold, Mental Ray, Nuke, and Houdini.

## Key Topics

- V-Ray rendering
- Arnold renderer
- Mental Ray / MILA materials
- Maya 3D modeling
- Automotive visualization
- Multi-pass compositing
- Nuke compositing
- Global illumination (GI)
- Render comparisons
- Quad modeling techniques
- VRayMtl and GGX
- HDRI lighting
- Houdini FLIP fluids
- CGI portfolio work

## Portfolio & Automotive Visualization

- [Portfolio Images (Automotive)](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2012/08/portfolio-images-automotive.html): Automotive CGI portfolio showcasing Maya, V-Ray, Nuke rendering work
- [Vehicle I just worked on](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2012/11/vehicle-i-just-worked-on.html): Ford Transit Connect Wagon CGI project for Boston Globe using Maya/V-Ray

## Rendering Workflows & Tutorials

- [My latest lecture on Multi-pass Compositing with V-Ray](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2013/12/my-latest-lecture-on-multi-pass.html): V-Ray multi-pass compositing lecture with Nuke by Dillon Bailey
- [MILA Mental Ray glossy reflection roughness -> V-Ray VRayMtl reflection glossiness (GGX)](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2016/10/mila-mental-ray-glossy-reflection.html): MILA Mental Ray to V-Ray GGX material conversion guide for glossiness
- [Modeling and rendering in V-Ray](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2012/09/modeling-and-rendering-in-v-ray.html): V-Ray rendering and quad modeling workflow demonstration in Maya
- [FREE Quality HDRS!!! I am very thankful for these people](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2014/12/free-quality-hdrs-i-am-very-thankful.html): Free HDRI resources from noemotionhdrs.com for image-based lighting

## Renderer Comparisons & Benchmarks

- [Arnold vs. V-Ray (significant difference)](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2012/10/arnold-vs-v-ray-significant-difference.html): Arnold vs V-Ray render performance and GI quality comparison
- [Nice V-Ray vs. Arnold benchmark over at MaxDepth](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2013/11/nice-v-ray-vs-arnold-benchmark-over-at.html): V-Ray vs Arnold benchmark comparison from MaxDepth for particle rendering

- [Arnold Interior Test (classroom)](https://pixelblackbox.blogspot.com/2012/10/arnold-interior-test-classroom.html): Arnold renderer interior test using aiSkyDomeLight on Mac Pro/Fedora
